subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 4 years at 14% per annum is Rs. 6,160 less than the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 8 years. Find the sum.
solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest for 4 years (SI₄) at 14% per annum is ₹6,160 less than simple interest for 8 years (SI₈) at the same rate.

Rate (R) = 14%

Time difference (t) = 8 - 4 = 4 years

SI₈ - SI₄ = ₹6,160

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time

**Calculations:**

SI₈ = (P × 14 × 8) / 100

SI₄ = (P × 14 × 4) / 100

SI₈ - SI₄ = ₹6,160

⇒ [(P × 14 × 8) / 100] - [(P × 14 × 4) / 100] = ₹6,160

⇒ (P × 14 × 4) / 100 = ₹6,160

⇒ (P × 56) / 100 = ₹6,160

⇒ P = (₹6,160 × 100) / 56

⇒ P = ₹11,000

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
